overview_description.description:
The SuperApp for on demand financial services. 

Launched during the pandemic, Finfirst digital platforms deliver a digital experience for  auto loans, personal loans , car insurance and business banking. If we have it on the app, you get it digitally. No physical visits no paper work no bureaucracy. Just the service , digital and delivered. 

Removing all physical interactions and payments  from financial transactions,  our customers enjoy a smooth digital journey from the comfort of their offices or homes.
